2608.23370.title: Walking on the DARKSIDE
2608.23370.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) recognise patterns but do not natively track the path of exclusions that a coherent discourse demands. When an input rests on a fabricated authority, a misapplied mechanism, or a surreptitious analogy, an unsteered LLM tends to engage with it as if it were grounded, and to reify the misstep into any structured output it generates. Logic-Augmented Generation (LAG) with POLANYI++, an LLM-steering method that uses heuristics, ontologies and problem solving methods for tacit knowledge extraction, produces an Extended Knowledge Graph (XKG) in OWL2, but inherits the same vulnerability: a sophisticated nonsensical input is reified into the graph alongside the legitimate triples, and is hardly detectable by automated reasoners since the XKG is generated jointly with the wrong assumptions. We introduce DARKSIDE, a coherence auditing method on top of POLANYI++. It formalises the trail as an explicit data structure of accumulated exclusions over discourse time, complemented by a warrant axis that classifies each named referent as Warranted, Unattested, Misattributed or Fabricated, with an escalation rule that pushes the DelegationRiskAssessment to UNSAFE when the fabricated rate is positive or the unsupported rate exceeds a threshold. We evaluate DARKSIDE as a steering layer over a Gemini 3 on BSBench, a 100-item adversarial corpus of sophisticated-sounding nonsense across software engineering, finance, healthcare, physics and law, with Claude Sonnet 4.6 as an independent judge. The empirical evidence supports an architectural claim: when an LLM forward pass is wrapped in an ontology-mediated negative-trail apparatus, the structural pattern-vs-path gap can be partially scaffolded. The XKG functions as the missing memory, and the warrant axis as an epistemic firewall.
2608.23370.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）能夠識別模式，但並不會本能地追蹤連貫論述所需的排除路徑。當輸入依賴於虛構的權威、錯誤應用的機制或隱蔽的類比時，未經引導的LLM傾向於將其視為有根據的，並將錯誤具象化為其生成的任何結構化輸出。使用POLANYI++的邏輯增強生成（LAG），這是一種利用啟發式、範疇和問題解決方法進行隱性知識提取的LLM引導方法，生成一個在OWL2中的擴展知識圖（XKG），但仍然繼承了相同的脆弱性：一個複雜的無意義輸入與合法的三元組一起被具象化到圖中，並且幾乎無法被自動推理器檢測到，因為XKG是與錯誤假設共同生成的。我們介紹了DARKSIDE，這是一種在POLANYI++之上的連貫性審核方法。它將排除的過程形式化為一種明確的數據結構，累積於論述時間上，並輔以一個保證軸，將每個命名參照分類為有保證、未證實、錯誤歸屬或虛構，並設有一個升級規則，當虛構率為正或未支持率超過閾值時，將DelegationRiskAssessment推至不安全。我們在BSBench上評估DARKSIDE作為Gemini 3的引導層，BSBench是一個包含100項複雜無意義的對抗語料庫，涵蓋軟體工程、金融、醫療、物理和法律，並以Claude Sonnet 4.6作為獨立評審。實證證據支持一個架構主張：當LLM的前向傳遞被包裹在一個由範疇介導的負面路徑裝置中時，結構模式與路徑之間的差距可以部分地架構起來。XKG作為缺失的記憶，而保證軸則作為一個認識論防火牆。
2608.23370.author: Aldo Gangemi et.al.
